sources.entry: FlutterFlow- FlutterFlow helps you build high quality, customized Mobile apps quickly. #paid

summary.name: FlutterFlow
summary.one_liner: FlutterFlow is a visual development platform for building mobile, web, and desktop apps with Flutter, with the option to export the generated code.
use_cases: Building mobile apps quickly without writing everything by hand
Prototyping an MVP for a startup
Connecting an app to Firebase or Supabase data
Collaborating with a team on app design and logic
Deploying one app to App Store, Play Store and the web
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a visual editor for building app UI and logic, including 200+ pre-designed UI elements and a visual Action Flow Editor for adding logic. It offers a Test Mode for testing and fixing bugs. Apps can connect to data through Firebase or Supabase integrations, third-party APIs, or a RESTful backend, and include built-in integrations for payments and maps. Teams can collaborate using branching, comments, and task assignment, and projects can be exported as code. The page says apps can be deployed to the App Store, Play Store, and the web.
notable: Exports the underlying Flutter code with no vendor lock-in
Visual Action Flow Editor for app logic
Branching and in-app comments for team collaboration
Marketplace of templates and a directory of agencies and freelancers
caveats: The listing marks it as paid; the page itself does not state specific plan prices.
Page is mostly marketing with testimonials; specific limits are not described.
